author: microscope_agent

observable.name: tracer_diffusivity
observable.definition: Short-time translational diffusion coefficient of dilute tracer spheres in the sample, read from the mean squared displacement of tracked centroids over lag times below the trap-free drift time.

constraint_notes: sample is consumed by the measurement and cannot be remounted
no calibration of the stage is available for this sample holder

numbers.name: target_decade_resolution
numbers.note: one decade is enough to tell whether the tracers are free or hindered

assumptions.statement: Screening only needs to place the diffusivity within one decade; the question is which regime the sample is in, not what the coefficient is.
assumptions.falsifier: if two candidate regimes fall inside the same decade, one decade is not enough and the goal must be restated

assumptions.statement: A centroid fit needs a signal to noise ratio of order five to keep the localisation error below a pixel; no measurement on this sample exists yet.
assumptions.falsifier: a localisation error above one pixel at this signal to noise ratio retires the assumption
